lines: Good day to you, traveller.
Have you come far?
Winter is coming, they say.
The Lannisters always pay their debts.
I pray the lords keep us safe.
It has been a hard season.
Have you news from the capital?
Mind you don't wander too far from the road.
The harvest was poor this year.
Stay out of trouble, stranger.
The ravens have been busy of late.
I've heard wolves in the hills at night.
We don't want any trouble here.
May the gods watch over you.
These are dark times for common folk like us.
A man must eat, whatever the season.
My lord's men came through not three days past.
There are worse places to be than here.
I've got work to be getting on with.
Have a care on the roads at night.
